mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO specialist or agency for my contracting company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO specialist or agency for your contracting company, look for expertise specifically in local SEO and answer engine optimization. Evaluate their track record with other service-based businesses, request case studies or examples of successful implementations, and ensure they understand the unique challenges and opportunities within the contractor industry. A good partner will focus on measurable results, provide transparent reporting, and demonstrate a clear strategy for optimizing your content for direct answers and voice search.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO specialist with proven local SEO and AEO expertise for service-based businesses. Look for case studies, transparent reporting, and a clear strategy for direct answers.
